usage.title: Using the API
usage.description: Call the API from your server, never from a web page: the key gives access to the library.

create.label: Create
create.description: Create the video, then upload its file to it.

upload.label: Upload
upload.description: Send the file in resumable chunks with tus, or POST a link to it to /videos/{videoId}/import and the server downloads it.

status.label: Wait
status.description: Poll the status until processing is ready, or add a webhook instead.

sign.label: Sign
sign.description: Only when the library requires signed URLs: get expiring playback URLs.

play.label: Play
play.description: Play the HLS playlist in your page once processing is ready; it needs no key.

usage.setup: Set these once on your server

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Your servers use the library ID and an API key to work with this library. Give each integration its own key with only the permissions it needs, and never put a key in a web page or app.
keys.limit_reached: A library can have at most {{max}} keys.
keys.empty: This library has no API keys yet.
keys.roll_description: The current secret stops working immediately, and so do the playback URLs signed with it. The key keeps its name and permissions.
keys.delete_description: The key stops working immediately, and the playback URLs signed with it stop working too. Other keys are not affected.

key_form.description: Name the key after what uses it, and allow only what that integration needs.
key_form.name: Name

videos_read.label: Read videos
videos_read.description: List videos and read their details and upload state.

videos_upload.label: Upload videos
videos_upload.description: Create videos and upload their files with tus.

playback_sign.label: Sign playback URLs
playback_sign.description: Create expiring playback URLs. Its URLs stop working if this permission is removed.

analytics_read.label: Read analytics
analytics_read.description: Read view counts, watch time and retention of the library's videos.

leads_read.label: Read leads
leads_read.description: List the email addresses viewers left in calls to action, e.g. to sync them to a CRM.

secret.title: Copy the secret now
secret.description: For your security it is shown only once. If you lose it, give the key a new secret.
secret.label: Secret

encoding.title: Transcoding qualities
encoding.description: Uploaded videos are transcoded to HLS in these qualities, so they play smoothly on any connection and device.
encoding.hint: Videos are never upscaled: qualities above a video's own size are skipped, and portrait videos use their short side. Changes apply to new uploads; process earlier videos again to apply them there.
encoding.owner_only_title: Only the owner can change encoding
encoding.owner_only_description: Ask the organization owner to change which qualities this library transcodes to.

player.title: Player appearance
player.description: Match the embedded player to your brand and choose which controls viewers get.
player.accent_color_hint: Colors the seek and volume bars. Pick a color that stands out against dark video.

showTitle.label: Title
showTitle.hint: Shows the video's title over the top of the player. An embed's title option overrides this.

showSettingsMenu.label: Quality and speed menu
showSettingsMenu.hint: Lets viewers pick a quality and playback speed. Without it, quality adapts to the connection.

showPictureInPicture.label: Picture-in-picture
showPictureInPicture.hint: Lets viewers keep watching in a floating window.

showFullscreen.label: Fullscreen
showFullscreen.hint: The fullscreen button, double-click and the F shortcut.

showChapters.label: Chapters
showChapters.hint: Splits the seek bar at each chapter and lets viewers jump between them, for videos that have chapters.

autoplayNext.label: Autoplay next video
autoplayNext.hint: In playlists, the next video starts by itself after a short countdown.

showCaptions.label: Captions
showCaptions.hint: A captions button and menu, for videos that have caption tracks.

player.hint: Changes apply to every embed of this library the next time it loads.
player.owner_only_title: Only the owner can change the player
player.owner_only_description: Ask the organization owner to change how this library's player looks.

security.title: Playback security
security.description: Decide which sites may play this library's videos, and whether they need signed URLs.
security.hosts_hint: A site is a host such as example.com, or *.example.com for all of its subdomains. With no sites, every site may play the videos; once you add one, players that hide the page they run on are blocked.
security.signed_hint: Videos play only through expiring URLs your server creates with the API key.
security.no_hosts: Every site may play this library’s videos.
security.owner_only_title: Only the owner can change playback security
security.owner_only_description: Ask the organization owner to change which sites may play this library's videos.

webhooks.owner_only_title: Only the owner can manage webhooks
webhooks.owner_only_description: Ask the organization owner to set up a webhook for this library.
webhooks.title: Webhook
webhooks.description: OpenStream sends a signed POST request to your URL whenever a video is created, renamed, uploaded, processed or deleted, or a viewer leaves an email address, so your servers don’t have to poll.

events.video_created: A video was created, from the dashboard or the API.
events.video_updated: A video was renamed, or its thumbnail or chapters changed.
events.video_deleted: A video was deleted. Its files are removed from storage shortly after.
events.video_uploaded: The whole file arrived and passed the checks.
events.video_upload_failed: The file was rejected, e.g. it is not really an MP4 or MOV, or an import could not download it.
events.video_processing_queued: The video is waiting for a worker: just uploaded, or sent to be processed again.
events.video_processing_started: Transcoding started. Sent once, not again on retries.
events.video_processing_ready: HLS, poster and storyboard are ready to play.
events.video_processing_failed: Transcoding failed on every attempt, or the file has no picture.
events.video_cta_submitted: A viewer left their email address in a call to action. Carries the address and the consent they gave.
events.webhook_test: Sent when you click "Send test event" on this page.
events.video_caption_ready: A caption track was added or replaced, by an upload or a transcription. Carries the track.
events.video_caption_deleted: A caption track was deleted. Carries the track as it was.
events.video_transcription_failed: A transcription couldn't make a track. Carries the transcription and why it failed.

webhooks.secret_description: Your server uses it to check that requests come from OpenStream. It is shown only once; if you lose it, give the webhook a new secret.
webhooks.roll_title: Give the webhook a new signing secret?
webhooks.roll_description: Deliveries are signed with the new secret right away, so update your server first or it will reject them.
webhooks.delete_description: No more events are sent, and the record of past deliveries is deleted.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.description: Events sent to the webhook in the last 30 days, newest first.
deliveries.empty: Nothing has been sent yet. Send a test event to check your endpoint.

webhooks.example_description: Every video event carries the video’s status as its data, the same shape the status endpoint returns. This is a video.processing.ready event.

receiving.verify: Check the webhook-signature header with the signing secret. Requests follow the Standard Webhooks specification, so its libraries can do it for you.
receiving.deduplicate: Use webhook-id to skip events you have already handled; a retry or resend keeps the same id.
receiving.answer: Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried with growing delays for about an hour.

webhooks.empty: No webhook yet. Add your endpoint’s URL to start receiving events.

url_dialog.description: OpenStream POSTs every event to this URL. In production it must be a public HTTPS address.

edit.title: Edit video
edit.description: Viewers see the title and description, for example in a playlist’s episodes menu.

captions.title: Captions
captions.description: Subtitles and captions players offer in a menu. Upload a WebVTT or SRT file, or transcribe the video with the library's provider. A new track in a language and kind the video already has replaces that one.
captions.delete_description: {{label}} is removed from the video and its file deleted.
captions.too_many: A video can have up to {{max}} caption tracks.
captions.edit_hint: To fix a track, download it, edit it in any subtitle editor, and upload it again in the same language.

transcribing.title: Transcribing…
transcribing.description: The provider is listening to the video. The track appears here when it's ready, usually within a few minutes.

reasons.provider_auth: The provider refused its API key. The organization's owner can update the key in Transcription.
reasons.provider_rejected: The provider refused the request, e.g. it doesn't know the model.
reasons.provider_unreachable: The provider couldn't be reached. Try again later.
reasons.provider_removed: The provider was deleted before the video was transcribed.
reasons.no_audio: The video has no sound to transcribe.
reasons.no_speech: The provider heard no speech in the video.
reasons.transcription_failed: Something went wrong while transcribing. Try again.
reasons.usage_limit_reached: The provider's monthly minute limit would have been passed.

upload.title: Upload a caption file
upload.description: A WebVTT (.vtt) or SRT (.srt) file. Its timings are kept and its text cleaned of anything but bold, italics and underline.
upload.dropzone_title: Drop a .vtt or .srt file here, or click to choose one

transcribe.title: Transcribe this video
transcribe.description: The library's provider turns the video's speech into a track. Providers charge for each transcription.

edit.title: Rename caption track
edit.description: Players list the track by this label.

section.title: Embed
section.description: Paste this code into any page to show the video in OpenStream's player.
section.autoplay_muted: Browsers only autoplay muted video, so the player starts muted.
section.restrictions: The library's playback rules still apply: only allowed hosts can show the player, and a library that requires signed playback needs an embed URL signed through the API (the embedUrl of the playback URLs).
section.playlist_description: Paste this code into any page to show the playlist in OpenStream's player. Viewers move between its videos with the episodes menu.

unavailable.not_ready: This video is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
unavailable.not_allowed: This video can't be played on this site.
unavailable.playlist_empty: This playlist has no videos to play yet.

analytics.description: Views of this library's embedded videos. Previews in the dashboard are not counted.
analytics.empty_period: No views in this period yet.

sites.title: Top sites
sites.empty: No views from embedding sites yet.

retention.title: Audience retention
retention.description: Share of views still watching at each point of the video.

dashboard.title: Analytics
dashboard.description: Views of every library's embedded videos together. Open a library for its own figures.

ctas.title: Calls to action
ctas.description: Of the views that showed each call to action, the share that answered it and the share that closed it.

storages.title: Storages
storages.description: Connect S3-compatible buckets once and assign them to any library.
storages.search_placeholder: Search by name, bucket or endpoint
storages.owner_only_title: Only the owner can manage storages
storages.owner_only_description: Storages hold access keys, so only the organization owner can see and change them.

empty.title: No storages yet
empty.description: Connect a bucket to store library videos outside the default storage.

no_results.title: No matching storages
no_results.description: No storage name, bucket or endpoint contains "{{search}}".

fields.name: Name
fields.keep_saved_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key

storages.variables_hint: Build the folder of each video from these variables. {videoId} is required so every video gets its own folder.
storages.locked_description: Video files are already stored here, so only the name and the keys can change.

connection.unreachable: The bucket could not be reached with these settings.

create.title: Connect a storage
create.description: Any S3-compatible service works, such as AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 or MinIO. We check the bucket can be reached before saving and store the keys encrypted.

edit.title: Edit storage
edit.description: The saved access key ends in {{hint}}. Enter new keys only to replace it.

delete.title: Delete storage?
delete.description: "{{name}}" will be removed. Files already in its bucket are not deleted.

activity.owner_only_title: Only the owner can see the activity log
activity.owner_only_description: Ask the organization owner if you need to know who changed something.
activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Who changed what in this organization, from the dashboard or with an API key. Expand an entry to see the values before and after.
activity.search_placeholder: Search people, keys, names and actions

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.description: Changes to libraries, videos, storages and the team show up here.

actions.api_key_rolled: Gave an API key a new secret
actions.webhook_secret_rolled: Gave a webhook a new secret
actions.video_reprocess_requested: Asked to process a video again

account_activity.title: Account activity
account_activity.description: Sign-ins to your account, failed attempts, password resets, and organizations you owned that were deleted. Expand an entry to see where it came from.

playlists.description: Group videos into playlists that play one after another in a single embed.

fields.title: Title
fields.description_placeholder: Shown at the top of the episodes menu

create.title: New playlist
create.description: Name the playlist; you add its videos next.

delete.title: Delete playlist?
delete.description: "{{title}}" will be deleted and its embeds will stop working. Its videos stay in the library.

empty.title: No playlists yet
empty.description: Create a playlist to embed several videos in one player, like a course or a series.

empty.title: No videos in this playlist
empty.description: Add videos from the library; you can change their order at any time.

videos.failed_hint_one: Its upload or processing failed, so viewers skip it. Open it in the Videos tab to upload the file again or reprocess it, or remove it here.
videos.failed_hint_other: Their upload or processing failed, so viewers skip them. Open them in the Videos tab to upload the files again or reprocess them, or remove them here.
videos.waiting_hint_one: Viewers see it in the playlist once its file is uploaded and processed.
videos.waiting_hint_other: Viewers see them in the playlist once their files are uploaded and processed.

edit.title: Edit playlist
edit.description: Viewers see the title and description at the top of the episodes menu.

leads.description: Email addresses viewers left in the library's calls to action, with the consent they gave. Leads stay when their call to action or video is deleted.

empty.title: No leads yet
empty.description: Add an email form to a video's calls to action, and addresses viewers leave show up here.

delete.title: Delete this lead?
delete.description: {{email}} is deleted for good, e.g. when the viewer asks to be forgotten. The activity log keeps no copy of the address.

transcription.owner_only_title: Only the owner can manage transcription providers
transcription.owner_only_description: Providers hold API keys, so only your organization's owner can see and change them.
transcription.title: Transcription providers
transcription.description: Connect OpenAI, or a speech-to-text server of your own that speaks OpenAI's API, and choose it in any library to turn videos into captions.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.description: Connect OpenAI with an API key, or point OpenStream at your own Whisper server.

delete.title: Delete this provider?
delete.description: {{name}} and its API key are removed for good. Caption tracks it made stay.

connection.working: The provider answered and accepted the key.
connection.unauthorized: The provider answered but refused the API key.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.description: Transcribe with OpenAI's speech-to-text API, billed to your OpenAI account.

openai_compatible.label: Your own server (OpenAI-compatible)
openai_compatible.description: Transcribe with a server you run that speaks OpenAI's transcription API, e.g. Speaches, faster-whisper-server or LocalAI.

fields.name: Name
fields.name_placeholder: e.g. Whisper on our GPU box
fields.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved key

hints.openai: Use whisper-1: it returns the timings captions need. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.openai_compatible: Enter the address that /audio/transcriptions is below, usually ending in /v1. The API key is optional.
hints.address_changed: Changing the address removes the saved API key. Enter it again if the new server needs one.
hints.monthly_limit: Limits the minutes of audio sent to this provider each calendar month. A video counts with its full length as soon as its transcription is requested; failed transcriptions don't count. Requests that would pass the limit are refused, and automatic transcriptions are marked failed. Leave empty for no limit.

chapter_generation.owner_only_title: Only the owner can manage chapter generation providers
chapter_generation.owner_only_description: Providers hold API keys, so only your organization's owner can see and change them.
chapter_generation.title: Chapter generation providers
chapter_generation.description: Connect OpenAI, or a model server of your own that speaks OpenAI's API, and choose it in any library to write chapters from captions with {{model}}.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.description: Connect OpenAI with an API key, or point OpenStream at your own model server.

delete.title: Delete this provider?
delete.description: {{name}} and its API key are removed for good. Chapters it suggested stay.

connection.working: The provider answered and accepted the key.
connection.unauthorized: The provider answered but refused the API key.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.description: Write chapters with OpenAI's API, billed to your OpenAI account.

openai_compatible.label: Your own server (OpenAI-compatible)
openai_compatible.description: Write chapters with a server you run that speaks OpenAI's chat completions API with structured outputs, e.g. vLLM or LiteLLM.

fields.name: Name
fields.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved key

hints.openai: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.openai_compatible: Enter the address that /chat/completions is below, usually ending in /v1. The server must serve a model named gpt-6-luna. The API key is optional.
hints.address_changed: Changing the address removes the saved API key. Enter it again if the new server needs one.
hints.monthly_limit: Tokens this provider may use each month, counting the transcript it reads and the chapters it writes. A one-hour video needs about 15,000 tokens; leave empty for no limit.
